title: A CLI test guards that a moved-basis refusal's JSON stderr never spells the locked-store phrase
outcome: A CLI test guards that a moved-basis refusal's JSON stderr never spells the locked-store phrase
acceptance: A binary-level test records an execution observation whose revision or workspace is 'database is locked', invokes real work evaluate with --json to a moved-basis refusal, and asserts exit 1, parseable JSON stderr without the literal phrase, and full recorded text decoded from details.deciding_observation

A binary-level test invokes the reachable core complete source-recovery refusal and asserts exit 1 and its actual JSON stdout without the literal 'database is locked' phrase while the deciding observation decodes to the full recorded text

Unit coverage preserves the shared refusal_stderr_text guard for StoreError variants whose source refusal cannot be reached through the core CLI error branch; no new CLI command or production behavior is added to manufacture that branch

completion.summary: Landed in bb1099a: a binary-level test pins that moved-basis evaluate and core completion refusals never spell the locked-store phrase while the recorded text decodes whole; unit coverage pins the stderr guard per refusal family.
